create_const_fill_op: create a Caffe2 constant fill operator from a NumPy array or Int8Tensor blob
construct_init_net_from_params: construct a Caffe2 init_net protobuf from a dictionary of parameter name to blob mappings
get_params_from_init_net: run a Caffe2 init_net and extract all output blobs as a params dictionary with device options
infer_device_type: infer the device type of each blob in a Caffe2 predict_net by static analysis
check_set_pb_arg: check or set a protobuf argument value on a Caffe2 operator with optional override support
